scope: October same-session controlled local-resolution experiment; September unused

rules.cross_validation: Supplementary EQ excludes the evaluation technique; frozen prior filters already saw this session, so this is a development stability check.
rules.confidence: Joint raw SNR over background, adequate fixed anchors and per-octave-scaled energy relevance. Group coverage, sign consistency and MAD lower fitting confidence.
rules.regularization: Same physical-frequency curvature, outside-zero response and coefficient penalties for all grids. Filter peak bandwidth matches estimation octave width; all score variants use common 1/12 octave masks.
rules.implementation_audit: Initial physical-curvature coefficient 0.06 numerically suppressed almost all fine-filter gains (<0.1dB for most 1/12 sections); it was changed to 0.002 before the meaningful resolution comparison. This remains an exploratory development study, not a preregistered independent experiment.
rules.selection: Finer must gain >=0.2dB LOTO group MAE without >5 percentage-point extra worsening. New middle EQ must gain >=0.15dB versus frozen current. Last piece omitted from fit and candidate choice.

application_scope.reason: Fine middle correction improves tonal group averages but worsens percussion middle balance; preserve the earlier middle filter for percussion. This is manual profile selection, not an automatic technique classifier.

percussion_experiment.scope: October same-session developmental percussion-duration relative magnitude experiment. First 8 hits design, final 5 held from new fit; prior EQ saw this session. No IR or phase inversion.

rules.gates: Common KM184 onset through maximum three-device observed tail, 40ms below peak -35dB/local quiet +6dB; 0.83s cap. 5ms edge taper, no full Hann that suppresses attack.
rules.resolution: 1/12 octave only where physical band width >=3/event duration; zero-padding does not create resolution. Joint raw SNR >=10dB, relevance weights, >=4/8 design-hit support and sign/MAD shrinkage.
rules.gain: One 200–600Hz gain learned on 8 design hits from latest output, frozen for both filters and all held hits.
rules.filter: Frozen latest 1/12 filter plus one 600–12k relative-EQ supplement; section -6/+4dB, total supplement absolute cap6dB, causal IIR. Under600Hz held approximately constant.
rules.selection: One candidate, no held-hit tuning or refitting; developmental comparison, not independent recording validation.
rules.limitation: Magnitude EQ cannot reconstruct phase, spatial radiation or decay differences. Gate detects acoustic energy, not verified hand-contact duration.

mixed_experiment.scope: Mixed-resolution percussion EQ development; same first8 design/final5 evaluation hits, already inspected in prior experiments. Not independent validation.

rules.candidates: Frozen latest low/mid EQ + broad1/3 only; broad1/3 then remaining1/6 residual; broad1/3 then remaining1/12 residual. No retuning on evaluation hits.
rules.limits: Same extra total ±6dB response cap; fine residual sections ±3dB; under600Hz approximately preserved.
rules.confidence: Raw-device and KM184 SNR, relevance, physical duration resolution, >=4/8 observed hits, sign consistency and MAD shrinkage. Same original 1/12 masks for every score.
rules.gain: Same previous fixed train-derived 200–600Hz gain in all event evaluations.
rules.scope: Magnitude-only EQ; mixing widths is not time-envelope or phase restoration.
